ترابطت (form VI)
# تَرَابَطْتُ (tarābaṭtu) /ta.raː.batˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
# تَرَابَطْتَ (tarābaṭta) /ta.raː.batˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
# تَرَابَطْتِ (tarābaṭti) /ta.raː.batˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَابَطَ (tarābaṭa)
# تَرَابَطَتْ (tarābaṭat) /ta.raː.ba.tˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
